facts.en: It has a white V-shaped mark on its chest, like a moon.
facts.zh: 牠的胸前有一個白色的V字形斑紋，像一彎月亮。

facts.en: It is the only kind of bear that lives wild in Taiwan.
facts.zh: 牠是臺灣唯一野生的熊。

facts.en: It is a good climber and makes "nests" of branches up in trees.
facts.zh: 牠很會爬樹，還會在樹上用樹枝做「熊窩」。

habitat.en: Mountain forests, mostly between 1,000 and 3,500 metres up.
habitat.zh: 山區森林，大多在海拔1,000到3,500公尺之間。

diet.en: Omnivore: acorns, fruit, young leaves, insects and small animals
diet.zh: 雜食：橡實、果實、嫩葉、昆蟲和小動物

lifeCycle.en: In winter, 1–2 tiny cubs are born in a den. At first their eyes are closed.
lifeCycle.zh: 冬天，媽媽在洞裡生下1到2隻小熊，剛出生時眼睛還沒張開。

lifeCycle.en: Cubs stay with their mum for about two years, learning where to find food.
lifeCycle.zh: 小熊跟著媽媽大約兩年，學習去哪裡找食物。

lifeCycle.en: Grown-up bears live on their own.

facts.en: It is the only monkey that lives wild in Taiwan — and it lives nowhere else.
facts.zh: 牠是臺灣唯一的野生猴子，而且只住在臺灣。

facts.en: It lives in family groups called troops.
facts.zh: 牠們成群生活，叫做「猴群」。

facts.en: It can stuff food into pouches in its cheeks to eat later.
facts.zh: 牠可以把食物塞進臉頰的頰囊，等一下再慢慢吃。

habitat.en: Forests and rocky cliffs, from the lowlands up to high mountains.
habitat.zh: 森林和岩壁，從低海拔到高山都有。

callouts.zh: 靈巧的手，可以幫同伴理毛

diet.en: Omnivore: fruit, young leaves, seeds and insects
diet.zh: 雜食：果實、嫩葉、種子和昆蟲

lifeCycle.en: Babies are born in spring and early summer, one at a time.
lifeCycle.zh: 小猴在春天到初夏出生，一次生一隻。

lifeCycle.en: A baby holds on to its mum's belly and rides along with her.
lifeCycle.zh: 小猴會緊緊抱住媽媽的肚子，跟著她到處走。

lifeCycle.en: Young monkeys play together and learn from the troop.
lifeCycle.zh: 小猴們一起玩耍，向猴群學習。

lifeCycle.en: Daughters stay in the troop; sons leave to join another one.
lifeCycle.zh: 母猴會留在原本的猴群；公猴長大後會離開，加入別的猴群。

facts.en: Its scales are made of keratin, the same stuff as your fingernails.
facts.zh: 牠的鱗片是角蛋白做的，跟你的指甲是一樣的材質。

facts.en: When it feels scared, it rolls up into a tight, scaly ball.
facts.zh: 感到害怕的時候，牠會把身體捲成一顆硬硬的球。

facts.en: It has no teeth. It slurps up ants and termites with a long, sticky tongue.
facts.zh: 牠沒有牙齒，靠又長又黏的舌頭來吃螞蟻和白蟻。

photo.author: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Headquarters

name.zhuyin: ㄊㄞˊ ㄨㄢ ㄔㄤˊ ㄗㄨㄥ ㄕㄢ ㄧㄤˊ

facts.en: It lives only in Taiwan and can climb steep, rocky cliffs with ease.
facts.zh: 牠只住在臺灣，可以輕輕鬆鬆爬上又陡又多石頭的山壁。

facts.en: Both males and females have short, pointy horns.
facts.zh: 公的和母的頭上都有短短尖尖的角。

facts.en: Its Chinese name means “long-maned mountain goat”, because of the longer hair on its neck.
facts.zh: 牠脖子上的毛比較長，像馬的鬃毛，所以叫做「長鬃山羊」。

facts.en: It is the biggest deer in Taiwan.
facts.zh: 牠是臺灣體型最大的鹿。

facts.en: Its Chinese name means “water deer”, because it loves bathing in water and rolling in mud.
facts.zh: 牠很喜歡泡水、在泥巴裡打滾，所以叫做「水鹿」。

facts.en: Every year, the male’s antlers fall off and new ones grow back.
facts.zh: 公鹿的角每年都會掉下來，然後再長出新的角。

photo.author: Denise Chan from Hong Kong, China

name.en: Red and White Giant Flying Squirrel

name.zhuyin: ㄒㄧ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄧ ㄉㄧˋ ㄉㄚˋ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄒㄧㄥ

facts.en: It lives only in Taiwan, and its tail is longer than the rest of its body.
facts.zh: 牠只住在臺灣，尾巴比身體其他部分加起來還要長。

facts.en: Older brothers and sisters help their parents feed the new chicks.
facts.zh: 家裡的哥哥姊姊會幫爸媽一起餵剛出生的小鳥。

facts.en: Its Taiwanese nickname means “long-tailed mountain lady”.
facts.zh: 臺語叫牠「長尾山娘」，意思是尾巴長長的山中姑娘。

silhouette.author: Lip Kee Yap (vectorized by T. Michael Keesey)

facts.en: The male has shiny blue-black feathers, a white crest and a bright red face.
facts.zh: 公鳥全身是發亮的藍黑色羽毛，頭上有白色的羽冠，臉是鮮紅色的。

facts.en: The female is brown, which helps her hide on the forest floor while she sits on her eggs.
facts.zh: 母鳥是褐色的，孵蛋的時候躲在森林地上，很不容易被發現。

facts.en: It lives only in Taiwan’s mountain forests and is very shy.
facts.zh: 牠只住在臺灣的山區森林裡，個性非常害羞。

facts.en: You can find it on the back of Taiwan’s 1,000-dollar note.
facts.zh: 臺灣的千元鈔票背面就有帝雉喔！

facts.en: It walks quietly through misty mountain forests, so people call it “the king of the mist”.
facts.zh: 牠常在起霧的高山森林裡安靜地走動，所以被叫做「迷霧中的王者」。

facts.en: The male’s long tail has white stripes across it.
facts.zh: 公鳥長長的尾巴上有一條條白色的橫紋。

facts.en: It has five bright colours (green, yellow, blue, red and black), which is why its Chinese name means “five-coloured bird”.
facts.zh: 牠身上有綠、黃、藍、紅、黑五種鮮豔的顏色，所以叫做「五色鳥」。

facts.en: Its “kok-kok-kok” call sounds like a monk tapping a wooden fish drum, so people nicknamed it “the colourful monk”.
facts.zh: 牠「咯、咯、咯」的叫聲很像和尚在敲木魚，所以有個外號叫「花和尚」。

facts.en: It digs its nest hole in old, soft tree trunks with its strong beak.
facts.zh: 牠會用強壯的嘴巴，在老樹幹上挖洞做巢。

facts.en: Its Chinese name means “turtle-shell flower”, because the brown pattern on its back looks like a turtle’s shell.
facts.zh: 牠背上的褐色花紋很像烏龜殼，所以叫做「龜殼花」。

facts.en: Two little pits on its face can feel the warmth of other animals, even in the dark.
facts.zh: 牠臉上有兩個小小的凹洞，就算在黑漆漆的地方，也能感覺到其他動物身上的熱。

facts.en: It is venomous. If you ever see one, don’t touch it: step back slowly and tell a grown-up.
facts.zh: 牠有毒！如果看到牠，千萬不要碰，慢慢退開，然後告訴大人。

photo.author: [Photo: A.V. Pham] Pham AV, Ziegler T, Nguyen TQ (2020) New records and an updated checklist of snakes from Son La Province, Vietnam. Biodiversity Data Journal 8: e52779. https://doi.org/10.3897/BDJ.8.e52779

facts.en: Most salmon swim out to the sea, but this one spends its whole life in mountain streams.
facts.zh: 大部分的鮭魚會游到大海，但牠一輩子都住在高山的溪流裡。

facts.en: It needs cold, clean water, so it lives in only a few streams high in the mountains.
facts.zh: 牠需要又冷又乾淨的水，所以只住在高山上少數幾條溪裡。

facts.en: People in Taiwan call it a “national treasure fish”.
facts.zh: 臺灣人叫牠「國寶魚」。

facts.en: It is one of the biggest moths in the world: its open wings can be as wide as a dinner plate.
facts.zh: 牠是世界上最大的蛾之一，翅膀張開來跟一個大盤子差不多寬。

facts.en: The tips of its wings look a bit like snake heads, which may help scare away hungry birds.
facts.zh: 牠翅膀尖端的花紋有點像蛇頭，可能可以嚇跑想吃牠的鳥。

facts.en: Grown-up Atlas moths have no working mouth, so they never eat and live for only one or two weeks.
facts.zh: 長大的皇蛾沒有可以用的嘴巴，所以完全不吃東西，只能活一到兩個星期。

facts.en: Migration is a long journey that animals make, often every year, to find food, warmth or a safe place to raise babies.
facts.zh: 遷徙是動物的長途旅行，常常每年都會出發，為了找食物、找溫暖的地方，或找安全的地方養寶寶。

facts.en: The Arctic tern makes the longest migration of any animal, flying from near the North Pole to near the South Pole and back every year.
facts.zh: 北極燕鷗是遷徙最遠的動物，每年從北極附近飛到南極附近，再飛回來。

facts.en: Every winter, black-faced spoonbills fly to Taiwan to escape the cold further north.
facts.zh: 每年冬天，黑面琵鷺會飛到臺灣，躲開北方的寒冷。

facts.en: It runs down the middle of Taiwan from north to south, like the island’s backbone.
facts.zh: 它從北到南穿過臺灣中間，就像臺灣的脊椎骨。

facts.en: Two huge pieces of the Earth’s crust are slowly pushing together here, so the mountains are still rising a tiny bit every year.
facts.zh: 地球上兩大塊地殼在這裡慢慢互相擠壓，所以這些山現在每年還在長高一點點。

facts.en: Rain that falls on the west side flows to the Taiwan Strait, and rain on the east side flows to the Pacific Ocean.
facts.zh: 下在山西邊的雨會流向臺灣海峽，下在東邊的雨會流向太平洋。

facts.en: Corals may look like plants or rocks, but they are really lots of tiny animals living together.
facts.zh: 珊瑚看起來像植物或石頭，其實是很多小小的動物住在一起。

facts.en: Kenting is at the southern tip of Taiwan, where warm sea water helps corals grow.
facts.zh: 墾丁在臺灣的最南端，溫暖的海水讓珊瑚長得很好。

facts.en: On a few spring nights after the full moon, many corals release their eggs at the same time, like an underwater snowstorm.
facts.zh: 春天滿月後的幾個晚上，很多珊瑚會同時排卵，看起來就像海底在下雪。

name.zhuyin: ㄕㄡˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄨㄢ ㄏㄟ ㄒㄩㄥˊ

facts.en: Scientists think there may be only a few hundred Formosan black bears left in the wild.
facts.zh: 科學家估計，野外的臺灣黑熊可能只剩下幾百隻。

facts.en: Rangers and volunteers walk through the forests to find and take away traps left by people, so bears can roam safely.
facts.zh: 保育人員和志工會走進森林，把人們留下的陷阱找出來拿走，讓黑熊可以安心地到處走。

facts.en: Since 1989, a law in Taiwan has protected the bears, so no one is allowed to hunt them.
facts.zh: 從 1989 年開始，臺灣的法律就保護臺灣黑熊，任何人都不可以獵捕牠們。

facts.en: Many birds have hollow bones filled with air, which keeps them light enough to fly.
facts.zh: 很多鳥的骨頭是中空的，裡面充滿空氣，讓牠們夠輕，才飛得起來。

facts.en: A bat’s wing is thin skin stretched between its very long finger bones.
facts.zh: 蝙蝠的翅膀是一層薄薄的皮膚，撐在牠很長的手指骨之間。

facts.en: Hummingbirds can hover in one spot and even fly backwards.
facts.zh: 蜂鳥可以停在空中不動，甚至還能倒著飛。

facts.en: It lived about 66 million years ago, long before there were any people.
facts.zh: 牠生活在大約六千六百萬年前，那時候世界上還沒有人類。

facts.en: Its biggest teeth, roots and all, were about as long as a banana.
facts.zh: 牠最大的牙齒連牙根算進去，差不多跟一根香蕉一樣長。

facts.en: Its arms were short, with just two fingers on each hand.
facts.zh: 牠的手臂很短，每隻手只有兩根手指。

photo.author: Connie Ma from Chicago, United States of America

facts.en: Most are less than 1 millimetre long, so you need a microscope to see one clearly.
facts.zh: 大部分還不到 1 公釐長，要用顯微鏡才看得清楚。

facts.en: It has eight chubby legs with tiny claws and plods along like a little bear.
facts.zh: 牠有八隻胖胖的腳，腳上有小爪子，走起路來慢吞吞的，像一隻小熊。

facts.en: It can survive drying out and freezing, and some have even survived a trip to outer space!
facts.zh: 牠可以撐過乾掉和結冰，有些甚至去過外太空還活著回來！

facts.en: It flowers in winter, around Lunar New Year, earlier than most other cherry trees.
facts.zh: 它在冬天、差不多過年的時候開花，比大部分的櫻花都早。

facts.en: Its deep pink flowers hang down like little bells.
facts.zh: 深粉紅色的花朵朝下開，像一個個小鈴鐺。

facts.en: Birds such as white-eyes visit the flowers to sip the sweet nectar.
facts.zh: 綠繡眼這些小鳥會飛來吸甜甜的花蜜。
